title: The Strongest Wizard Making Full Use of the Strategy Guide -No Taking Orders, I'll Slay the Demon King My Own Way-
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Magnus, a wizard who is constantly ordered around by the party's hero, is kicked out of the party. Soon after, he obtains a book written in the language of the gods that works as an ultimate strategy guide to defeating the Demon King, and he sets out to do it his own way. Plot details beyond the setup were not available in the sources consulted.
life_message: Refusing to be pushed around and using knowledge wisely can let an underestimated person do what the proud hero could not.
